units.description: SNAP QC public-use microdata: one row per sampled SNAP unit (household), with the weights FYWGT (fiscal-year average) and HWGT (one month) and the chosen variables, from the CSV zip of a fiscal year (FY 2014 on). Columns fiscal_year, database and state_abbr are added; every other value is as published.

fiscal_year.desc: fiscal year(s), 2014 to the latest (CSV files; one or a list; FY 1996-2013 are SAS/Stata/SPSS only)

period.desc: FY 2020 only: full (default; Oct 2019-Feb 2020 and Jun-Sep 2020, no Mar-May), per1 (Oct 2019-Feb 2020) or per2 (Jun-Sep 2020)

variables.desc: unit-level variables: names (FSBEN), stems with * for numbered columns (AGE* = AGE1 to AGE18; ELEMENT* = error findings 1 to 9), or "all" (1,177 columns in FY 2024). Default: a core set (source.md). The id columns are always kept. --search finds names

state.desc: optional: states or territories to keep (USPS codes, FIPS codes or names)

month.desc: optional: one sample month, YYYYMM (202401), within the fiscal year

persons.description: The same file reshaped to one row per person listed in the unit's household (person number 1 to 16 or 18): person-level variables (AGE, SEX, FSAFIL...) by stem, with the unit's ids and weights. FSAFIL = 1 marks a SNAP participant.

fiscal_year.desc: fiscal year(s), 2014 to the latest (CSV files; one or a list; FY 1996-2013 are SAS/Stata/SPSS only)

period.desc: FY 2020 only: full (default; Oct 2019-Feb 2020 and Jun-Sep 2020, no Mar-May), per1 (Oct 2019-Feb 2020) or per2 (Jun-Sep 2020)

state.desc: optional: states or territories to keep (USPS codes, FIPS codes or names)

month.desc: optional: one sample month, YYYYMM (202401), within the fiscal year

person_variables.desc: person-level stems (AGE, SEX, WAGES; without the number). Default: FSAFIL REL AGE SEX RACETH CTZN DIS WORK

variables.desc: unit-level variables to carry on each person row (default: FSUSIZE FSBEN)

participants_only.desc: true: keep only persons with FSAFIL = 1 (default false)

summary.description: Weighted totals computed from the file by state and for the U.S.: SNAP units, persons (FSUSIZE) and benefits (FSBEN), average monthly over the file's months (or one month), with averages per unit and per person and the unweighted sample count. A quick check against FNA's published totals; FY 2024 is compared with its tech doc.
